paragraphs.text: The Burning Isles are a highly volcanic archipelago. It lies in the easternmost part of the Domains north of Jamuraa and west of Corondor on the plane of Dominaria .

The islands are notorious for their habitation by panther warriors , nightstalkers , embermages and necromancers . A dozen lords, each entity mighty, all claim dominion. There are 3 named islands in the archipelago:
Around 4050 AR , the Shipbuilders' Guild systematically started logging the woods of the Burning Isles. Multani was sent as an envoy to stop them.
